game.comment: What Game mode changes (new in Backbloom): its values replace the matching ones of smoothing, color.channelAdjustment[0] and systemGrabber while Game mode is on, without saving them there (Engine/GameTuning). Defaults: the Intense preset of the UI (ui/src/settings/intensity.ts) and its spring (springFor(150)), 60 fps.
game.title: Game mode

layout.comment: LED layout (the UI's LayoutSpec): controllers with outputs and driver settings, strips wired to outputs. The envelope is checked here; Layout/LayoutSpecification validates the rest.

modes.comment: Ambient and Game mode (new in Backbloom): the mode chosen in the app. A profile marked as a game switches to Game mode while it runs (Engine/ModeMonitor). What Game mode changes is the game section.
modes.title: Modes

homeAssistantDiscovery.title: Add the lights to Home Assistant (MQTT discovery)
